### CRITICAL Issues (MUST FIX -- Blocks Deploy)

**1. [shopify.server.ts:13] -- API version mismatch: using `ApiVersion.October25` instead of `2026-01`**

The `shopify.app.toml` declares `api_version = "2026-01"` for webhooks, but `app/shopify.server.ts` line 13 uses `ApiVersion.October25`. This inconsistency means admin API calls use a different version than webhook subscriptions. The CLAUDE.md spec requires `2026-01`. Update `shopify.server.ts` to use `ApiVersion.January26` (or whatever the package exports for 2026-01).

**2. Missing GDPR webhook handlers -- `customers/data_request`, `customers/redact`, `shop/redact`**

Only `webhooks.app.uninstalled.tsx` and `webhooks.app.scopes_update.tsx` exist. The three mandatory GDPR webhook routes are entirely missing, and `shopify.app.toml` has no subscriptions for them. This is a hard requirement for the "Built for Shopify" badge and Shopify App Store review.

Files to create:
- `app/routes/webhooks.customers.data_request.tsx`
- `app/routes/webhooks.customers.redact.tsx`
- `app/routes/webhooks.shop.redact.tsx`

Add corresponding `[[webhooks.subscriptions]]` entries in `shopify.app.toml`.

**3. [app.pricing.tsx:72-117] -- Billing action does NOT call Shopify Billing API**

Lines 93-99 simulate subscription by writing directly to the local DB without calling `admin.graphql()` to create an `AppSubscription`. This means:
- No actual charge is created on Shopify's side
- Merchants get "paid" features for free
- Complete billing bypass

**2. Widget Button Position radio cards (lines ~1073-1097)** -- Replaced the custom `<div role="button">` + `<input type="radio">` pattern with a single Polaris `ChoiceList` component. **3. Country Targeting radio cards (lines ~1112-1131)** -- Same treatment as issue 2. Replaced with Polaris `ChoiceList` with two choices ("all" and "selected"), using `helpText` for descriptions. **5. Empty state for assignments (lines ~941-949)** -- Replaced the custom dashed-border `<div>` with Polaris `EmptyState` component with a `heading` and Shopify CDN image. The descriptive text is rendered as a child.

- **Add row button** (line ~624): Replaced the raw `<button>` with `Button variant="plain"`.

## Polaris UI/UX Overhaul Summary

### [app.size-charts.$id.tsx](app/routes/app.size-charts.$id.tsx) — Chart Editor (14 fixes)
- **Tabs**: Replaced `ButtonGroup` tabs with Polaris `Tabs` (fitted, 5 tabs)

- **Table buttons**: All raw `<button>` elements replaced with Polaris `Button` + `Tooltip`
- **Radio cards**: Widget position & country targeting replaced with Polaris `ChoiceList`
- **Assignment list**: Custom divs replaced with `ResourceList` + `ResourceItem`
- **Empty state**: Custom dashed box replaced with Polaris `EmptyState`

### [app.widget.tsx](app/routes/app.widget.tsx) — Widget Customizer (7 fixes)
- **Border radius**: Raw `<input type="range">` replaced with Polaris `RangeSlider`
- **Custom CSS**: Raw `<textarea>` replaced with Polaris `TextField multiline monospaced`
- **Color picker**: Swatch wrapped in Polaris `Box` with 44px touch target + `aria-label`
- **Display mode cards**: Polaris `Box` with `borderWidth`/`borderColor`/`background` tokens
- **Position grid**: Raw CSS grid replaced with Polaris `InlineGrid columns={2}`
- **Border swatches**: Wrapped in Polaris `Tooltip` showing pixel values

### [app.recommender.tsx](app/routes/app.recommender.tsx) — AI Recommender (5 fixes)
- **Algorithm/Fit cards**: Replaced `outline: "2px solid #005bd3"` with Polaris `Box` using `borderWidth="050"`, `borderColor="border-focus"`, `background="bg-surface-selected"`
- **Body type grid**: Same Polaris `Box` token treatment
- **Flex containers**: Raw `<div style="display:flex">` replaced with `InlineStack gap="400" wrap`

### [app.analytics.tsx](app/routes/app.analytics.tsx) — Analytics (3 fixes)
- **Bar chart**: Bars wrapped in `Tooltip` for hover values, `Box` with `background="bg-fill-brand"`
- **Rank badge**: Raw circle div replaced with Polaris `Box borderRadius="full"` + `Text`

### [app._index.tsx](app/routes/app._index.tsx) — Dashboard (2 fixes)
- **Step circles**: Raw divs replaced with Polaris `Box borderRadius="full"` + `background="bg-fill-emphasis"`
- **Accordion steps**: Polaris `Box` with dynamic `background` for expand/collapse visual feedback

### [app.size-charts.tsx](app/routes/app.size-charts.tsx) — Charts List (4 fixes)
- **Progress bar**: Custom 20-line div replaced with `ProgressBar progress={pct} size="small" tone={tone}`
- **Category filter**: Raw div replaced with `Box minWidth="160px"`
- **CSV import layout**: Raw flex divs replaced with `InlineGrid columns={["twoThirds","oneThird"]}`
- **Chart name overflow**: Proper `Box minWidth="0"` for text truncation

Build a complete page/feature for the Size Chart & Recommender Shopify app: 

You MUST execute ALL 6 phases automatically. Do NOT stop until production-ready. Do NOT ask for confirmation between phases — just execute.

---

## PHASE 1: RESEARCH (use Explore agent)

Spawn an **Explore agent** to analyze the current codebase:
- Read CLAUDE.md for all rules
- Read existing route patterns (app._index.tsx, app.tsx, app.size-charts.tsx)
- Read prisma/schema.prisma for current models
- Read app/lib/plans.ts for plan gating
- Read app/lib/templates.ts if relevant
- Identify which existing patterns to follow
- Identify what Prisma models exist vs what's needed

Also spawn a **general-purpose agent** to research competitors:
- Search for competitor Shopify apps with similar features
- Document what they do well (UI patterns, UX flows)
- Identify differentiator opportunities
- Note Shopify Polaris patterns for this page type

Run both agents **in parallel**. Collect findings.

---

## PHASE 2: ARCHITECT (you do this directly)

Based on research, plan:
1. **Route type**: `app.*` (admin) / `api.*` (public) / component
2. **Prisma models**: New or existing? Schema changes needed?
3. **Data flow**: loader → component → action
4. **Plan gating**: Which plan minimum?
5. **Component structure**: What sub-components needed?
6. **State management**: Server (loader) vs client (useState) vs URL (searchParams)

If database changes are needed:
- Add to prisma/schema.prisma
- Run `npx prisma migrate dev --name descriptive_name`
- Run `npx prisma generate`

---

## PHASE 3: DESIGN (you do this directly)

Define the visual design decisions:
- Match the dashboard design language (cardStyle, badgeStyle, sectionTitle patterns)
- Define all component states: default, hover, loading, empty, error
- Define layout structure (main content + sidebar)
- Plan all copy/text (no placeholders)
- Reference competitor patterns for best UX

---

## PHASE 4: BUILD (use multiple builder agents in parallel)

Split the work across **parallel builder agents**:
- If building a page: one agent per major section/file
- If building a feature: one agent per route file
- Each agent gets: full context (CLAUDE.md rules, design decisions, existing patterns)

Requirements for ALL agents:
- `authenticate.admin(request)` at top of every admin loader/action
- `where: { shop: session.shop }` on every DB query
- try/catch in every action
- App Bridge toasts for mutations
- Loading states, empty states
- TypeScript strict — zero `any`
- Match existing design language exactly

---

## PHASE 5: QA (use quality-gate agent)

After all builders finish, spawn a **quality-gate agent**:
- Run `npx tsc --noEmit` — must be ZERO errors
- Check auth on every admin route
- Check DB queries scoped to shop
- Check error handling in every action
- Check toast feedback for mutations
- Check loading/empty states exist
- Check plan gating if applicable
- Check CORS headers on public API routes

If ANY issues found: fix them directly, don't ask.

---

## PHASE 6: COMMIT & REPORT

After QA passes:
1. `git add` all changed files
2. `git commit` with descriptive message
3. Auto-push via post-commit hook

```
**How to test**: [steps]
```

I'll compile and present the comprehensive analysis of missing and broken features identified during the code exploration.

## MISSING & BROKEN FEATURES REPORT

### 1. FEATURES REFERENCED IN CLAUDE.MD BUT NOT IMPLEMENTED

#### A. Multi-Language Support (Translate & Adapt)
- **Reference**: CLAUDE.md states "native Shopify Translate & Adapt integration"
- **Status**: NOT IMPLEMENTED
- **Evidence**: No Translate & Adapt hooks in any route files. No i18n configuration in app. No language context or translation provider.
- **Impact**: High — marketed as competitive differentiator but code doesn't support it.

#### B. Return Attribution Analytics
- **Reference**: CLAUDE.md lists "return attribution" as Growth/Pro feature
- **Status**: MISSING FROM SCHEMA
- **Evidence**: `prisma/schema.prisma` has `AnalyticsEvent` model with eventType field, but schema only defines: view, click, recommend, convert, dismiss. No return-related events or return rate tracking fields.
- **Impact**: High — promised in pricing plans but database schema doesn't support it.

#### C. Advanced ML Recommender (Pro Plan)
- **Reference**: CLAUDE.md claims Pro plan includes "Advanced ML recommender"
- **Status**: IMPLEMENTED AT BASIC LEVEL ONLY
- **Evidence**: `app/lib/ai.server.ts` implements simple BMI-based estimation with hardcoded coefficients. No ML model integration, no training, no model versioning. Both Growth and Pro use the same algorithm.
- **Impact**: Medium-High — Pro plan advertises advanced ML but code shows basic static algorithm.

#### D. Dedicated Sizing Page
- **Reference**: CLAUDE.md lists "dedicated sizing page" as Growth feature
- **Status**: NOT IMPLEMENTED
- **Evidence**: No route file named `app.sizing.tsx` or similar. Growth plan gating references non-existent feature.
- **Impact**: Medium — Growth plan feature that doesn't exist in routes.

#### E. Multi-Store Support (Pro Plan)
- **Reference**: CLAUDE.md claims "multi-store" as Pro feature
- **Status**: NOT IMPLEMENTED
- **Evidence**: All database queries filter by `shop: session.shop`. No multi-store tenant structure, no organization model, no cross-shop permissions.
- **Impact**: Low (single-store focus is valid) but advertised feature missing.

#### F. GDPR Data Request/Redact Webhooks
- **Reference**: CLAUDE.md rule #23 states "GDPR handlers required: `customers/data_request`, `customers/redact`, `shop/redact`"
- **Status**: NOT IMPLEMENTED
- **Evidence**: No webhook route files for these three handlers. Only generic webhook placeholder exists.
- **Impact**: Critical — non-compliance with Shopify app requirements and GDPR.

---

### 2. SETUP STEPS LINKING TO NON-FUNCTIONAL FEATURES

#### Issue: Dashboard Setup Steps Incomplete
- **File**: `app/routes/app._index.tsx` (lines 80-120)
- **Problem**: Dashboard defines 4 setup steps:
  1. "Create your first size chart" → Works (links to size-charts page)
  2. "Assign charts to products/collections" → Works (links to size-charts editor)
  3. "Customize the widget" → Works (links to widget customizer)
  4. "Enable AI recommender" (optional) → **Breaks** (references `app.recommender.tsx` which doesn't exist)
- **Evidence**: No route file at `app/routes/app.recommender.tsx` exists in the codebase.
- **Impact**: Step 4 button click will cause 404 navigation error.

---

### 3. CLIENT-ONLY STATE THAT SHOULD PERSIST TO DATABASE

#### A. Display Settings (CRITICAL)
- **File**: `app/routes/app.size-charts.$id.tsx` (lines 1020-1149)
- **Fields**: `priority`, `buttonPosition`, `selectedCountries`
- **Problem**: 
  - UI allows merchants to set these on "Position" tab
  - Values are stored in local state via `setDisplaySettings()`
  - When form is submitted, displaySettings ARE included in payload (line 739-740)
  - BUT: These settings only affect how the chart row displays in the admin list, NOT how the widget renders on storefront
  - Reload the page → values disappear (lost local state)
- **Code Evidence**:
  ```typescript
  // Lines 670-674: Read from chartData
  const [displaySettings, setDisplaySettings] = useState({
    priority: chartData.displaySettings?.priority || 50,
    buttonPosition: chartData.displaySettings?.buttonPosition || 'floating',
    selectedCountries: chartData.displaySettings?.selectedCountries || []
  });
  ```
  - Values saved to `fullData.displaySettings` (line 739) but widget on storefront doesn't use these values
- **Impact**: High — merchants configure display behavior that has no effect and is lost on reload.

#### B. Widget Custom CSS
- **File**: `app/routes/app.widget.tsx` (lines 150-180)
- **Problem**: 
  - UI has textarea for custom CSS input (line 356)
  - State is managed locally via `setCustomCSS()`
  - On submit, custom CSS is included in payload BUT examining `WidgetConfig` schema in prisma, there's no `customCSS` field
  - Custom CSS is not persisted to database
- **Evidence**: `prisma/schema.prisma` WidgetConfig model has no customCSS field. Payload attempts to save it but it's silently ignored by Prisma.
- **Impact**: High — users can't customize widget styling persistently.

#### C. Widget Feature Toggles
- **File**: `app/routes/app.widget.tsx` (lines 100-120)
- **Problem**: "Enable AI Recommender" toggle in widget customizer appears to be client-only state
- **Code Evidence**: No `aiRecommenderEnabled` or similar field in WidgetConfig schema
- **Impact**: Medium — can't toggle widget features persistently.

---

### 4. MISSING DATABASE FIELDS FOR FEATURES SHOWN IN UI

#### A. WidgetConfig Missing Fields
- **Schema**: `prisma/schema.prisma` WidgetConfig
- **Missing Fields**:
  - `customCSS` (referenced in `app.widget.tsx` line 356)
  - `aiRecommenderEnabled` (toggle referenced in widget customizer)
  - `messageText` / `messageContent` (appears in UI but not in schema)
  - `borderRadiusValue` (color picker for border radius exists but no field to store it)
- **Impact**: High — features show in UI but can't be persisted.

#### B. SizeChart Missing Fields
- **Schema**: `prisma/schema.prisma` SizeChart
- **Issues**:
  - `displaySettings` are stored inside `data: Json` field instead of top-level columns
  - No way to query by displaySettings.priority or displaySettings.buttonPosition
  - No fields for measurement guide content, return/size-related metadata
- **Impact**: Medium — inefficient querying and storage design.

#### C. AnalyticsEvent Missing Fields
- **Current**: `eventType` only includes view/click/recommend/convert/dismiss
- **Missing**: 
  - No return-related events for "return attribution" feature mentioned in plans
  - No fields for tracking size accuracy (e.g., "recommendedSize", "actualSizePurchased", "returnedDueToSize")
  - No field for recommendation confidence
- **Impact**: High — can't track return attribution or recommendation accuracy as promised.

---

### 5. TEMPLATE PICKER FUNCTIONALITY VERIFICATION

#### Status: WORKS BUT LIMITED
- **File**: `app/routes/app.size-charts.tsx` (action handler, lines 116-156)
- **Evidence**:
  ```typescript
  case 'create-from-template': {
    const { templateId } = formData;
    const template = TEMPLATES.find(t => t.id === templateId);
    if (!template) return json({ error: 'Template not found' }, { status: 400 });
    // Creates new chart with template data
    await db.sizeChart.create({
      data: {
        shop: session.shop,
        name: template.name,
        type: template.type,
        category: template.category,
        data: template.data, // Copies template table data
        status: 'draft'
      }
    });
  }
  ```
- **Finding**: Template creation DOES work — it copies `template.data` (the table/measurements) to the new chart
- **Limitation**: Only copies table structure. Does NOT copy `displaySettings`, sizing rules, or other config that might have been on the template
- **Impact**: Low-Medium — templates work for basic use case but don't provide full pre-configuration.

---

### 6. ANALYTICS DATE RANGE FILTER VERIFICATION

#### Status: WORKS CORRECTLY
- **File**: `app/routes/app.analytics.tsx` (lines 47-68)
- **Evidence**:
  ```typescript
  const fromParam = searchParams.get('from');
  const toParam = searchParams.get('to');
  const presetParam = searchParams.get('preset') || '7d';
  
  const dates = getDateRange(presetParam, new Date());
  const fromDate = fromParam ? new Date(fromParam) : dates.from;
  const toDate = toParam ? new Date(toParam) : dates.to;
  
  const events = await db.analyticsEvent.findMany({
    where: {
      shop: session.shop,
      sizeChartId: chartId,
      createdAt: { gte: fromDate, lte: toDate }
    }
  });
  ```
- **Finding**: Date filtering implementation is correct. Uses URL params for persistence, calculates date ranges properly, applies filters to DB queries
- **Impact**: No issues — this feature works as intended.

---

### 7. DISPLAY SETTINGS PERSISTENCE VERIFICATION

#### Status: NOT PERSISTED TO STOREFRONT
- **File**: `app/routes/app.size-charts.$id.tsx` (lines 1020-1149, 669-677, 739-741)
- **Problem Chain**:
  1. UI allows setting `priority`, `buttonPosition`, `selectedCountries` on "Position" tab
  2. These are saved to chart JSON in database as `chartData.displaySettings`
  3. BUT: The storefront widget (`extensions/size-chart-widget/blocks/size-chart.liquid`) does NOT read these settings
  4. Widget uses its own Liquid block settings schema, not chart displaySettings
  5. Result: Display settings are silently stored but never used
- **Evidence**:
  - `size-chart.liquid` (lines 1-50) defines Liquid schema with block settings for position/styling
  - Widget calls API endpoint `/api.size-chart.tsx` which returns chart data but displaySettings are in the `data: JSON` field
  - Widget ignores displaySettings and uses Liquid block schema settings instead
- **Impact**: Critical — users configure display behavior that has zero effect on actual widget display.

---

### 8. ADDITIONAL BROKEN/DEAD FUNCTIONALITY

#### A. CSV Import Without Data Validation

I'll compile and present the comprehensive analysis of missing and broken features identified during the code exploration.

## MISSING & BROKEN FEATURES REPORT

### 1. FEATURES REFERENCED IN CLAUDE.MD BUT NOT IMPLEMENTED

#### A. Multi-Language Support (Translate & Adapt)
- **Reference**: CLAUDE.md states "native Shopify Translate & Adapt integration"
- **Status**: NOT IMPLEMENTED
- **Evidence**: No Translate & Adapt hooks in any route files. No i18n configuration in app. No language context or translation provider.
- **Impact**: High — marketed as competitive differentiator but code doesn't support it.

#### B. Return Attribution Analytics
- **Reference**: CLAUDE.md lists "return attribution" as Growth/Pro feature
- **Status**: MISSING FROM SCHEMA
- **Evidence**: `prisma/schema.prisma` has `AnalyticsEvent` model with eventType field, but schema only defines: view, click, recommend, convert, dismiss. No return-related events or return rate tracking fields.
- **Impact**: High — promised in pricing plans but database schema doesn't support it.

#### C. Advanced ML Recommender (Pro Plan)
- **Reference**: CLAUDE.md claims Pro plan includes "Advanced ML recommender"
- **Status**: IMPLEMENTED AT BASIC LEVEL ONLY
- **Evidence**: `app/lib/ai.server.ts` implements simple BMI-based estimation with hardcoded coefficients. No ML model integration, no training, no model versioning. Both Growth and Pro use the same algorithm.
- **Impact**: Medium-High — Pro plan advertises advanced ML but code shows basic static algorithm.

#### D. Dedicated Sizing Page
- **Reference**: CLAUDE.md lists "dedicated sizing page" as Growth feature
- **Status**: NOT IMPLEMENTED
- **Evidence**: No route file named `app.sizing.tsx` or similar. Growth plan gating references non-existent feature.
- **Impact**: Medium — Growth plan feature that doesn't exist in routes.

#### E. Multi-Store Support (Pro Plan)
- **Reference**: CLAUDE.md claims "multi-store" as Pro feature
- **Status**: NOT IMPLEMENTED
- **Evidence**: All database queries filter by `shop: session.shop`. No multi-store tenant structure, no organization model, no cross-shop permissions.
- **Impact**: Low (single-store focus is valid) but advertised feature missing.

#### F. GDPR Data Request/Redact Webhooks
- **Reference**: CLAUDE.md rule #23 states "GDPR handlers required: `customers/data_request`, `customers/redact`, `shop/redact`"
- **Status**: NOT IMPLEMENTED
- **Evidence**: No webhook route files for these three handlers. Only generic webhook placeholder exists.
- **Impact**: Critical — non-compliance with Shopify app requirements and GDPR.

---

### 2. SETUP STEPS LINKING TO NON-FUNCTIONAL FEATURES

#### Issue: Dashboard Setup Steps Incomplete
- **File**: `app/routes/app._index.tsx` (lines 80-120)
- **Problem**: Dashboard defines 4 setup steps:
  1. "Create your first size chart" → Works (links to size-charts page)
  2. "Assign charts to products/collections" → Works (links to size-charts editor)
  3. "Customize the widget" → Works (links to widget customizer)
  4. "Enable AI recommender" (optional) → **Breaks** (references `app.recommender.tsx` which doesn't exist)
- **Evidence**: No route file at `app/routes/app.recommender.tsx` exists in the codebase.
- **Impact**: Step 4 button click will cause 404 navigation error.

---

### 3. CLIENT-ONLY STATE THAT SHOULD PERSIST TO DATABASE

#### A. Display Settings (CRITICAL)
- **File**: `app/routes/app.size-charts.$id.tsx` (lines 1020-1149)
- **Fields**: `priority`, `buttonPosition`, `selectedCountries`
- **Problem**: 
  - UI allows merchants to set these on "Position" tab
  - Values are stored in local state via `setDisplaySettings()`
  - When form is submitted, displaySettings ARE included in payload (line 739-740)
  - BUT: These settings only affect how the chart row displays in the admin list, NOT how the widget renders on storefront
  - Reload the page → values disappear (lost local state)
- **Code Evidence**:
  ```typescript
  // Lines 670-674: Read from chartData
  const [displaySettings, setDisplaySettings] = useState({
    priority: chartData.displaySettings?.priority || 50,
    buttonPosition: chartData.displaySettings?.buttonPosition || 'floating',
    selectedCountries: chartData.displaySettings?.selectedCountries || []
  });
  ```
  - Values saved to `fullData.displaySettings` (line 739) but widget on storefront doesn't use these values
- **Impact**: High — merchants configure display behavior that has no effect and is lost on reload.

#### B. Widget Custom CSS
- **File**: `app/routes/app.widget.tsx` (lines 150-180)
- **Problem**: 
  - UI has textarea for custom CSS input (line 356)
  - State is managed locally via `setCustomCSS()`
  - On submit, custom CSS is included in payload BUT examining `WidgetConfig` schema in prisma, there's no `customCSS` field
  - Custom CSS is not persisted to database
- **Evidence**: `prisma/schema.prisma` WidgetConfig model has no customCSS field. Payload attempts to save it but it's silently ignored by Prisma.
- **Impact**: High — users can't customize widget styling persistently.

#### C. Widget Feature Toggles
- **File**: `app/routes/app.widget.tsx` (lines 100-120)
- **Problem**: "Enable AI Recommender" toggle in widget customizer appears to be client-only state
- **Code Evidence**: No `aiRecommenderEnabled` or similar field in WidgetConfig schema
- **Impact**: Medium — can't toggle widget features persistently.

---

### 4. MISSING DATABASE FIELDS FOR FEATURES SHOWN IN UI

#### A. WidgetConfig Missing Fields
- **Schema**: `prisma/schema.prisma` WidgetConfig
- **Missing Fields**:
  - `customCSS` (referenced in `app.widget.tsx` line 356)
  - `aiRecommenderEnabled` (toggle referenced in widget customizer)
  - `messageText` / `messageContent` (appears in UI but not in schema)
  - `borderRadiusValue` (color picker for border radius exists but no field to store it)
- **Impact**: High — features show in UI but can't be persisted.

#### B. SizeChart Missing Fields
- **Schema**: `prisma/schema.prisma` SizeChart
- **Issues**:
  - `displaySettings` are stored inside `data: Json` field instead of top-level columns
  - No way to query by displaySettings.priority or displaySettings.buttonPosition
  - No fields for measurement guide content, return/size-related metadata
- **Impact**: Medium — inefficient querying and storage design.

#### C. AnalyticsEvent Missing Fields
- **Current**: `eventType` only includes view/click/recommend/convert/dismiss
- **Missing**: 
  - No return-related events for "return attribution" feature mentioned in plans
  - No fields for tracking size accuracy (e.g., "recommendedSize", "actualSizePurchased", "returnedDueToSize")
  - No field for recommendation confidence
- **Impact**: High — can't track return attribution or recommendation accuracy as promised.

---

### 5. TEMPLATE PICKER FUNCTIONALITY VERIFICATION

#### Status: WORKS BUT LIMITED
- **File**: `app/routes/app.size-charts.tsx` (action handler, lines 116-156)
- **Evidence**:
  ```typescript
  case 'create-from-template': {
    const { templateId } = formData;
    const template = TEMPLATES.find(t => t.id === templateId);
    if (!template) return json({ error: 'Template not found' }, { status: 400 });
    // Creates new chart with template data

        shop: session.shop,

        data: template.data, // Copies template table data
        status: 'draft'
  ```

- **Impact**: Low-Medium — templates work for basic use case but don't provide full pre-configuration.

### 6. ANALYTICS DATE RANGE FILTER VERIFICATION

- **Evidence**:

  ```typescript
  const fromParam = searchParams.get('from');
  ```

// This is your Prisma schema file,
// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

// Note that some adapters may set a maximum length for the String type by default, please ensure your strings are long
// enough when changing adapters.
// See https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/reference/prisma-schema-reference#string for more information
datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = "file:dev.sqlite"
}

model Session {
  id            String    @id
  shop          String
  state         String
  isOnline      Boolean   @default(false)
  scope         String?
  expires       DateTime?
  accessToken   String
  userId        BigInt?
  firstName     String?
  lastName      String?
  email         String?
  accountOwner  Boolean   @default(false)
  locale        String?
  collaborator  Boolean?  @default(false)
  emailVerified Boolean?  @default(false)
  refreshToken        String?
  refreshTokenExpires DateTime?
}

model SizeChart {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop      String
  name      String
  type      String   @default("table") // table, visual, image
  category  String   @default("general") // tops, bottoms, dresses, shoes, kids, rings, sportswear, general
  data      String   @default("{}") // JSON: { headers, units, rows }
  isDefault Boolean  @default(false)
  status    String   @default("active") // active, draft, archived
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  assignments ChartAssignment[]

  @@unique([shop, name])
  @@index([shop])
  @@index([shop, status])
}

model ChartAssignment {
  id              String @id @default(cuid())
  shop            String
  sizeChartId     String
  assignmentType  String // product, collection, tag, product_type, all
  assignmentValue String // product ID, collection ID, tag name, product type name, or "*"

  sizeChart SizeChart @relation(fields: [sizeChartId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([shop, sizeChartId, assignmentType, assignmentValue])
  @@index([shop, assignmentType, assignmentValue])
}

model SizeChartTemplate {
  id       String  @id @default(cuid())
  name     String
  category String  // tops, bottoms, dresses, shoes, kids, rings, sportswear
  gender   String  @default("unisex") // male, female, unisex
  data     String  @default("{}") // JSON: { headers, units, rows }
  isSystem Boolean @default(true)
}

model RecommenderConfig {
  id          String  @id @default(cuid())
  shop        String  @unique
  enabled     Boolean @default(false)
  algorithm   String  @default("basic") // basic, advanced
  bodyTypes   String  @default("[]") // JSON array of enabled body types
  sizingRules String  @default("{}") // JSON custom sizing rules
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
}

model WidgetConfig {
  id              String @id @default(cuid())
  shop            String @unique
  displayMode     String @default("popup") // popup, inline, both
  position        String @default("bottom-right") // bottom-right, bottom-left, top-right, top-left
  triggerType     String @default("button") // button, link, tab
  primaryColor    String @default("#000000")
  successColor    String @default("#16a34a")
  errorColor      String @default("#dc2626")
  backgroundColor String @default("#ffffff")
  textColor       String @default("#111111")
  borderRadius    String @default("8")
  heading         String @default("Size Guide")
  placeholder     String @default("Select your size")
  buttonText      String @default("Find My Size")
  successMessage  String @default("This size should fit you well!")
  errorMessage    String @default("We couldn't determine your size. Please refer to the chart.")
  showRecommender Boolean @default(true)
  customCss       String @default("")
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt
}

model AnalyticsEvent {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop        String
  sizeChartId String?
  eventType   String   // view, click, recommend, convert, dismiss

1→# Size Chart & Recommender — Project Brain 2→ 3→## What This App Does 4→A Shopify embedded app that helps merchants reduce size-related returns (~40-70% of apparel returns) by providing: 5→1. **Custom size charts** — visual, mobile-responsive tables assigned to products/collections 6→2. **AI size recommender** — ML-based body prediction from height/weight/body type 7→3. **Storefront widget** — popup + inline display via theme app extension (app block) 8→4. **Analytics dashboard** — chart views, recommendation accuracy, return attribution 9→5. **Multi-language support** — native Shopify Translate & Adapt integration 10→ 11→## Competitive Positioning 12→We beat competitors on: transparent flat pricing (no per-order fees), mobile-first bulletproof rendering, sub-5-minute setup, native i18n, and "Built for Shopify" badge. Primary target: merchants switching from Kiwi Sizing (bugs, slow support, hidden fees). 13→ 14→## Stack (Exact Versions — Never Deviate) 15→| Layer | Technology | Version | Notes | 16→|-------|-----------|---------|-------| 17→| Framework | React Router 7 | `@shopify/shopify-app-react-router` v1 | **NOT Remix** — imports from `react-router`, never `@remix-run/*` | 18→| UI | Shopify Polaris | v13+ via web components (``, ``, etc.) | Use Polaris web components as shown in template | 19→| App Bridge | `@shopify/app-bridge-react` | v4 | `useAppBridge()` for toasts, navigation, modals | 20→| Auth | `shopify.server.ts` | — | `authenticate.admin(request)` before ANY Shopify API call | 21→| Database | Prisma | v6 | SQLite (dev) / PostgreSQL (prod) | 22→| Language | TypeScript | Strict mode | Zero `any` types. Zero plain `.js` files. | 23→| Bundler | Vite | v6 | With `vite-tsconfig-paths` | 24→| Node | — | >=20.19 | Required by Shopify CLI | 25→| API Version | Shopify Admin GraphQL | 2026-01 | Set in Perfect! Now I have comprehensive data on both apps. Let me compile the detailed comparison report.

## COMPREHENSIVE COMPARISON: ZIP-CODE vs SIZE CHART & RECOMMENDER

### 1. PACKAGE DEPENDENCIES

| Aspect | Zip-Code | Size Chart | Match? | Notes |
|--------|----------|-----------|--------|-------|
| `@prisma/client` | `^6.19.2` | `^6.16.3` | DIFFER | Zip-Code has newer patch version |
| `@react-router/*` | `^7.12.0` | `^7.12.0` | MATCH | Both on same major version |
| `@shopify/app-bridge-react` | `^4.2.4` | `^4.2.4` | MATCH | Identical |
| `@shopify/polaris` | `^13.9.5` | `^13.9.5` | MATCH | Identical |
| `@shopify/polaris-icons` | NOT PRESENT | `^9.3.1` | MISSING | Size Chart imports from polaris-icons; Zip-Code uses icons from polaris directly |
| `@shopify/shopify-app-session-storage-prisma` | `^8.0.0` | `^9.0.0` | DIFFER | Size Chart is on newer major version (v9 vs v8) — **CRITICAL DIFFERENCE** |
| `postmark` | `^4.0.7` | NOT PRESENT | EXTRA | Zip-Code includes email service; Size Chart doesn't |
| `prisma` (devDep) | `^6.19.2` | NOT IN DEPS (only client) | DIFFER | Zip-Code has prisma in devDeps; Size Chart uses v6.16.3 |

### 2. NPM SCRIPTS

| Script | Zip-Code | Size Chart | Match? |
|--------|----------|-----------|--------|
| `build` | `react-router build` | `react-router build` | MATCH |
| `dev` | `shopify app dev` | `shopify app dev` | MATCH |
| `typecheck` | `react-router typegen && tsc --noEmit` | `react-router typegen && tsc --noEmit` | MATCH |
| `lint` | `eslint --ignore-path...` | `eslint --ignore-path...` | MATCH |
| `setup` | `prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy` | `prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy` | MATCH |
| `docker-start` | `npm run setup && npm run start` | `npm run setup && npm run start` | MATCH |
| All other scripts | IDENTICAL | IDENTICAL | MATCH |

### 3. FOLDER STRUCTURE

**Zip-Code:**
```
app/
  utils/          ← Utilities dir
  routes/
  billing.server.ts
  email.server.ts ← EXTRA: Email service
  plans.ts
  shopify.server.ts
  db.server.ts
```

**Size Chart:**
```
app/
  lib/            ← Library dir (vs utils)
    ai.server.ts          ← EXTRA: AI recommender logic
    analytics.server.ts   ← EXTRA: Analytics aggregation
    billing.server.ts     ← EXTRA: Billing logic in lib/
    templates.ts          ← EXTRA: Size chart templates
    plans.ts
  routes/
  shopify.server.ts
  db.server.ts
```

**Difference:** Size Chart uses `app/lib/` with more specialized server utilities (AI, analytics, templates), while Zip-Code has `app/utils/` and `billing.server.ts` at root.

### 4. VITE CONFIG

**Match:** IDENTICAL in both files. Both use:
- `@react-router/dev/vite` plugin
- `vite-tsconfig-paths`
- Same HMR configuration
- Same build settings (`assetsInlineLimit: 0`)

### 5. TYPESCRIPT CONFIG

**Match:** IDENTICAL. Both have:
- `strict: true`
- `skipLibCheck: true`
- `isolatedModules: true`
- Same target (ES2022), module (ESNext), jsx (react-jsx)

### 6. ROOT COMPONENT (`root.tsx`)

| Aspect | Zip-Code | Size Chart | Match? |
|--------|----------|-----------|--------|
| Imports | Same React Router imports | Same | MATCH |
| Meta tags | Identical | Identical | MATCH |
| Chatwoot widget | YES — embedded script | NO | DIFFER |
| Structure | `<html><head><Links/><Meta/><body><Outlet/><Scripts/>` | Same | MATCH |

**Difference:** Zip-Code includes Chatwoot live chat JavaScript widget in root; Size Chart does not.

### 7. ENTRY SERVER (`entry.server.tsx`)

**Match:** IDENTICAL. Both have:
- Same renderToPipeableStream logic
- Same isbot detection
- Same stream timeout (5000ms)
- Identical error handling

### 8. SHOPIFY SERVER SETUP (`shopify.server.ts`)

| Aspect | Zip-Code | Size Chart | Match? | Details |
|--------|----------|-----------|--------|---------|
| API Version | `ApiVersion.January26` = "2026-01" | `ApiVersion.October25` = "2025-10" | **DIFFER** | **CRITICAL**: Zip-Code is on 2026-01, Size Chart is on 2025-10 |
| Billing config | YES — 6 plans with trialDays: 7 | NO billing config | DIFFER | Zip-Code has full billing setup; Size Chart doesn't |
| Session storage | `PrismaSessionStorage(prisma)` | `PrismaSessionStorage(prisma)` | MATCH |
| Distribution | `AppDistribution.AppStore` | `AppDistribution.AppStore` | MATCH |
| Exports | Re-exports all from shopifyApp | Same | MATCH |

**Critical Issues:**
1. **API Version Mismatch**: Zip-Code (2026-01) vs Size Chart (2025-10) — this is a major version difference
2. **Billing not configured**: Size Chart's `shopify.server.ts` has NO billing configuration, while Zip-Code's is fully set up

### 9. DATABASE SETUP (`db.server.ts`)

**Zip-Code:**
```typescript
const prisma = global.prismaGlobal ?? new PrismaClient();
if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production") {
  global.prismaGlobal = prisma;
}
```

**Size Chart:**
```typescript
if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production") {
  if (!global.prismaGlobal) {
    global.prismaGlobal = new PrismaClient();
  }
}
const prisma = global.prismaGlobal ?? new PrismaClient();
```

**Difference:** Logic flow slightly different (Zip-Code assigns conditionally; Size Chart checks first), but both achieve singleton pattern.

### 10. ROUTE PATTERNS

**Zip-Code routes:**
- `app._index.tsx` — Dashboard with zip stats, theme detection
- `app.zip-codes.tsx` — ZIP code CRUD with CSV import/export
- `app.delivery-rules.tsx` — Delivery rules management
- `app.waitlist.tsx` — Waitlist entries
- `app.widget.tsx` — Widget customization
- `app.settings.tsx`, `app.pricing.tsx`, `app.help.tsx`, `app.feature-requests.tsx`
- `api.zip-check.tsx`, `api.widget-config.tsx`, `api.waitlist.tsx`
- `webhooks.*.tsx` (6 webhook handlers)

**Size Chart routes:**
- `app._index.tsx` — Dashboard with chart stats, analytics
- `app.size-charts.tsx` — Chart list/CRUD
- `app.size-charts.$id.tsx` — Chart editor (single chart)
- `app.recommender.tsx` — AI recommender settings
- `app.analytics.tsx` — Analytics dashboard
- `app.widget.tsx` — Widget customization
- `app.settings.tsx`, `app.pricing.tsx`
- `api.size-chart.tsx`, `api.recommend.tsx`, `api.widget-config.tsx`, `api.analytics-event.tsx`
- `webhooks.*.tsx` (5 webhook handlers)

**Match:** Both follow same React Router 7 file-based routing pattern. Different features = different routes.

### 11. NAVIGATION (`app.tsx`)

**Zip-Code:**
```tsx
<s-app-nav>
  <s-link href="/app/zip-codes">Zip Codes</s-link>
  <s-link href="/app/delivery-rules">Delivery Rules</s-link>
  <s-link href="/app/waitlist">Waitlist</s-link>
  <s-link href="/app/widget">Widget Customization</s-link>
  <s-link href="/app/settings">Settings</s-link>
  <s-link href="/app/help">Help & Support</s-link>
</s-app-nav>
```

**Size Chart:**
```tsx
<s-app-nav>
  <s-link href="/app">Dashboard</s-link>
  <s-link href="/app/size-charts">Size Charts</s-link>
```
